property.name: Go Gator Resort & Spa
property.fictionalDisclaimer: Fictional property for chatbot training purposes. All names, rates, and policies are illustrative
taglines: Where Every Stay Feels Like Paradise

address.locationDescription: Northwest Gainesville, 15 minutes from Gainesville International Airport

highlights: 3 outdoor pools (1 adults-only, 1 family, 1 lazy river)

rooms.name: Garden View Room
rooms.description: Surrounded by lush tropical gardens, featuring private patio or balcony and artisanal amenities. Only room category offering pet-friendly accommodations.

rooms.name: Resort View Room
rooms.description: Scenic views overlooking resort interior lagoons, designer swimming pools, and illuminated courtyard fountains.

rooms.name: Ocean View Room
rooms.description: Elevated coastal vistas across the palm tree canopy toward the Atlantic/Gulf coast with spacious private terraces.

rooms.name: Ocean Front Room
rooms.description: Prime beachfront location offering unobstructed horizon-to-horizon ocean views and direct proximity to the beach boardwalk.

rooms.name: Junior Suite
rooms.description: Expansive open-concept living area with pull-out luxury sofa bed, dual marble vanities, and soaking tub.

rooms.name: Executive Suite
rooms.description: Distinguished suite featuring an independent private bedroom, dedicated executive living salon, dining area, and wet bar.

rooms.name: Two-Bedroom Villa
rooms.description: Our most prestigious residence with two private master suites, equipped kitchenette, private lanai terrace, and secluded estate grounds.

diningVenues.name: Go Gator Buffet
diningVenues.description: Vibrant culinary stations showcasing global flavors, carved prime roasts, artisanal pastries, and made-to-order omelets.

diningVenues.name: The Waterfront
diningVenues.allInclusive: One specialty dinner reservation per stay per adult included ($45/adult, $20/child for additional dinners)
diningVenues.description: Refined oceanfront dining offering wild-caught coastal seafood, raw bar delicacies, and panoramic sunset views.
diningVenues.activeBulletin: Closing early at 8:00 PM tonight for a private event.

diningVenues.name: The Gator Grill
diningVenues.description: Signature chops, dry-aged steaks, and grilled local favorites served in an intimate upscale Florida lodge setting.

diningVenues.name: Tiki Bar
diningVenues.description: Polynesian Tiki craftsmanship, artisanal Asian cocktails, sake pairings, and light bites amidst torchlit gardens.

diningVenues.name: Lagoon Lounge
diningVenues.description: Sophisticated indoor/outdoor cocktail salon with craft mixology, live evening music, and savory tapas.

diningVenues.name: Swamp View
diningVenues.description: Refreshing poolside bar serving frozen daiquiris, craft beers, and cold coconut waters directly to your sun lounger.

included: One specialty dinner reservation per stay per adult at The Waterfront
allInclusiveDetails.dietaryAccommodations: Gluten-free, vegan, kosher-style, and allergy-conscious menus available at all venues. Kosher and halal requests require 24-hour advance notice.

pools.name: Family Pool
pools.description: Large interactive pool with zero-depth entry and family splash zones.
pools.activeBulletin: Closing early at 6:00 PM today for a private event.

pools.name: Serenity Adults-Only Pool
pools.description: Peaceful adults-only sanctuary with daybeds, chilled towels, and tranquil ambience.

pools.name: Lazy River
pools.description: Continuous gentle flow current tubing course looping through resort grounds.

cabanaRental.loyaltyPerk: Complimentary on weekdays for Platinum Gators members

laundry.valet: Same-day valet laundry (drop off by 9 AM)

spa.activeBulletin: On Sunday, spa opens at 10 AM due to scheduled maintenance.
spa.thermalSuite: Sauna, steam, whirlpool included with any treatment or day pass ($45)

signatureTreatments.name: Ocean Mineral Massage
signatureTreatments.description: Mineral-rich therapeutic stone massage relieving muscle tension.

signatureTreatments.name: Coastal Glow Facial
signatureTreatments.description: Deeply moisturizing marine antioxidant facial rejuvenating coastal skin.

signatureTreatments.name: Couples Retreat Package
signatureTreatments.description: Side-by-side aromatherapy massages with champagne and private thermal suite time.

spa.bookingRecommendation: Recommend booking 48+ hours in advance for weekend slots
spa.cancellationPolicy: 24-hour notice required or a 50% charge applies

kidsClub.dayCamp: 9 AM–5 PM daily, $0 for all-inclusive guests (includes lunch & activities)

teenLounge.features: Game room, movie nights, beach volleyball tournaments, self check-in with wristband

eveningEntertainment: Live music nightly at Lobby Lounge
Weekly rotating theme nights (Luau, Casino Night) posted at Concierge and TV Channel 4

airportShuttle.activeBulletin: Due to temporary staffing limitations, airport shuttle currently requires 24-hour advance booking.

golfCourseShuttle.hours: Runs hourly 6:30 AM–6 PM to 18-hole partner golf course

loyaltyProgram.name: Gator Rewards
loyaltyProgram.enrollment: Free, instant sign-up at booking, front desk, or via app/website
loyaltyProgram.pointsEarning: 10 points per $1 on room rate + dining/spa spend
loyaltyProgram.freeNightRedemption: 20,000 points = 1 free night (standard room, non-peak dates)
loyaltyProgram.statusMatch: Available by emailing loyalty@gogator.example with proof of elite status

benefits: Room service delivery fee & service charge waived
Complimentary cabana rental on weekdays (current promotion)

checkInOut.guaranteedEarlyOrLate: $50 in advance (10 AM check-in or 2 PM check-out, subject to availability)
checkInOut.requirements: Valid photo ID and credit card required at check-in; incidental hold of $150/night authorized

cancellation.standardRooms: Free cancellation up to 5 days before arrival; inside 5 days, one night's charge
cancellation.suitesAndVillas: Free cancellation up to 14 days before arrival; inside 14 days, 50% of stay charged

childrenAndExtraGuests.cribs: Complimentary, request at booking or via front desk

pets.limits: 2 pets max, 50 lb combined weight limit
pets.serviceAnimals: Exempt from fee and room restrictions

smoking.designatedAreas: Designated outdoor smoking areas near parking structure

ageRequirements.guests18to20: May book with parent/guardian consent on file

acceptedCards: Debit with sufficient credit for holds
payment.currency: USD only; on-site currency exchange available at front desk
payment.resortFeeAndTaxes: Non-waivable and apply regardless of rate plan

damageAndLostItems.lostAndFound: Held 90 days; shipping charged to guest if requested after departure
damageAndLostItems.damage: Charged to card on file within 5 business days with itemized receipt

inRoomRequests.deliveryTime: ~35 minutes standard, ~20 minutes for breakfast peak
inRoomRequests.deliveryFee: $6 + 18% service charge (waived for Gators tier and above)
inRoomRequests.orderingChannels: In-room tablet, Guest Experience app, or dial extension 55

fulfillmentTimes.notes: Can be scheduled for specific time

fulfillmentTimes.type: Do Not Disturb / Make Up Room toggle
fulfillmentTimes.notes: Can also be set via in-room panel

commonBookings: Excursions (snorkeling tours, golf tee times, city day trips, sunset cruises)
Private events (routed to Events team if >10 guests)
Babysitting service (independent contractor, $25/hr, 2-hr min, 24-hr advance notice)

leadTimes.dining: Same-day possible, recommend booking by 4 PM for evening slots
leadTimes.excursions: 24 hours minimum, some (golf) require 48 hours in peak season
leadTimes.privateEvents: Minimum 2 weeks, routed to human Events Coordinator

conciergeWorkflows.confirmationProtocol: All bookings generate a confirmation number and sync to guest stay itinerary in the app

reservationModificationFlow: 1. Verify identity (confirmation number + last name, or loyalty number)
2. State current reservation details and confirm what's changing
3. Quote any rate difference or fee
5. Process change and send updated confirmation email

customerGroups.needs: Families, couples, business travelers, and leisure guests. Key interests: beachfront recreation, pools, dining, golf, spa services, family activities.

Individual travelers, families, small groups. Value multilingual assistance, convenient transportation, detailed itinerary information, clear explanations of services and policies.
Leisure travelers, families, couples, business visitors. Value clear communication, convenient activity planning, accommodations, dining, shopping, recreation, excursions.
Families, couples, leisure travelers. Seeking beach vacation, family-friendly activities, dining, entertainment, convenient transportation and excursion options.
